scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd backend && uv sync --extra live && uv run python -m kavach.setup
scripts.dev:offline: cross-env BRAIN_PROVIDER=fake BAND_ENABLED=false TARGET_MODEL=fake TARGET_URL=inprocess FAKE_DELAY_S=1 turbo run dev --filter=@kavach/dashboard --filter=@kavach/web --filter=@kavach/api
scripts.demo: cd backend && uv run --extra live python -m kavach.record_demo
scripts.referee: cd backend && uv run --extra live python -m kavach.band.live_referee
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run python -m pytest -q
